a.title: Microsoft struggling to restore service as global outage affects Outlook and Teams

b.lede: Tech company says operations restored to all customers and regions affected by one of worst IT failures in years Microsoft has said its service has been fully restored after a massive outage that saw widespread disruption to governments, businesses and public services around the world. The technology company said on Saturday morning it had restored service to the remaining customers
b.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after global outage hits governments
